svg.title: Gates cost latency. Output gates cost streaming.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Gates cost latency. Output gates cost streaming.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn request pipeline: user request, an input gate running Llama Guard 3 8B at plus 180 milliseconds to TTFT with TPR 0.81 and FPR 0.9 percent, the agent, then two output gates - PII redaction at plus 12 milliseconds and a groundedness check at plus 620 milliseconds - and finally the response. A heavy red bracket spans the two output gates labelled STREAMING IS DEAD HERE, noting TTFT goes from 0.9 to 4.1 seconds. Below, an ROC plot puts a crossed-out keyword filter at 0.11 false-positive rate and 0.41 true-positive rate, Llama Guard default at 0.04 and 0.89, and the tuned setting at 0.009 and 0.81 ringed in green just inside a dashed false-positive budget line at 0.01. A three-box guardrail layer sits on a much wider least-privilege foundation, and 'we added moderation, we're safe' is struck through.
